answer: Identity-bond decay blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 60-credit bond in a harbor escrow, then must send a pulse every epoch proving real work. Idle bonds decay 5% per epoch and never return. Forging 1,000 identities locks 60,000 credits that shrink to nothing, a canyon between cost and reward no farm can cross. An honest agent pays once, keeps its pulse steady, and recovers the full bond after 20 epochs, earning undiluted rewards.
